name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2161: A cross-family review of v2155 broke three claims and all three are fixed here. THE PRUNER IS DISARMED AGAIN and the v2154 proof was wrong: stash_screen_open returns None for this is not a stash screen AND for at least two states where it could not measure, and one of them is the exact frame the guard exists to protect, because stash_chrome_canons comes back empty when a HOVER TOOLTIP covers the tab strip and the tooltip is the only place an item name exists. So panel is not None cannot mean the gate said no, and v2154 shipped a deleter on that reading. The gate already counts its own two blind states, GATE_SILENT and gate_failures, and a per-frame delta across them is the honest next step. THE RELAUNCH GUARD WAS WRONG AT BOTH ENDS: agent_mode is written only by start and stop so after a crash it stays live while the agent is dead, and v2155 would then refuse ON AIR on every tick for the life of the process, never firing the relaunch he asked for twice, the same failure facing the other way. And reel_is_growing never raises, it returns True on exception, so an unreadable footage directory produced the sentence frames are still landing, a fabricated measurement, while the except branch guarding it was dead for the real function.
